body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> Sonoro Audio introduced its two new products ‘cubo fusion’ and ‘cubo elements’ at CES 2008.
Each come in a black, high-gloss lacquered finish with a brushed, LED-illuminated metal
ring control knob, adding new, sophisticated designs to the cubo product line of luxury CD / MP3 clock radios.

Audiophiles can now conveniently select their favorite songs via remote control while their iPod recharges in the internal docking station of the new cubo fusion. In addition to a slot-in CD player, the product is equipped with a new key-lock to secure the unit, making it ideal for hotels and other commercial environments.

cubo elements Internet/FM version incorporates Internet radio for the modern music buff, allowing consumers to choose among 10,000 radio stations, selecting songs by geography or genre. cubo elements AM/FM model picks up excellent radio reception and lets individuals pre-set up to ten of their favorite stations. Like its cubo fusion counterpart, cubo elements enriches the listening experience with an integrated bass-reflex tube and a top-quality, full-range speaker.
“As iPods and Internet radio have become increasingly important music sources for
today’s audio enthusiasts, manufacturers must find ways to meet this growing trend,”
said Marcell Faller, founder and CEO of Sonoro Audio. “The introduction of our cubo
